# shared-read RTL 进展 2026-10-09

## 一句话
最终 build06 的 12 个完整 copy（run14–21, 24–27）通过验收；旧版本 7 个 PASS、6 个失败、2 个参数未知排除均保留。

## 验收范围
真实 iDMA/IOMMU RTL 仿真，off-board。每 reset 两次正常 2KiB job，单页 SameBank，静态成功许可。两 DMA 各 issue/done 一次、各返回 2048B、两目标各写 256 拍；源/目标未拷贝区域逐字节检查。

## 实际数字
| 场景 | candidate(mode1) V/A | tile(mode2) V/A | 派生 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 无暂停 latency31 | 5657/5650 | 8579/8572 | 平均减 34.07%（约34.1%） |
| 无暂停 latency100 | 6692/6685 | 18377/18370 | 平均减 63.6% |
| 暂停10000 cut64 | 3438/13450 | 3571/13496 | V 快 3.72%，A 0.34% |
| early resume B64+背压 | 3763/4293 | 3802/4332 | V 快 1.03%，A 0.90% |
| long pause B64+背压 | 3763/13712 | 3802/13712 | V 快 1.03%，A 持平 |
| closed mode0 | 15635/15628 | — | tile 是必要较强对照 |

物理 AR：mode1 1 burst vs mode2 128 burst，payload 均 256 拍。暂停 cut64 时 R=512-8=504。early resume run20/21 实际 3181 恢复、3254 detach；long pause run24/25 13171 恢复。

## 失败保留
run01 bad ID guard root bug（exit -6）；run02 WRITE walk 与 held shared R 死锁；run08/09 提前 resume AW 抢在 V 前死锁；run12/13 字节通过但严格 observer 漏计同周期 AW/W（exit 1）；run22/23 exit0 但未知 +ptw-lat，实际 latency31，排除延迟对比。

## 成本边界
最终 iDMA BufferDepth 3/flow，payload 24B×2=48；新 skid 8B，合计 56B 仅三个位置。XBAR/cuts、TC W FIFO、原 parent/recipe/header、控制和观察 state 未计；无综合 LUT/FF/timing，不称全系统或同面积最优。

## 下一门
先强化普通可变分片/有限先读控制，并列全资源/暂停义务预算；再扩多页 READ/WRITE 成功前沿：物理 read 不得越过尚未授权 destination，resume 守写序。比较双流平均/最坏时间、pause 债务、重读量与状态成本，随后决定生产整合、综合和上板。

## 引用
仅复用已有：DMA-Latte 2511.06605v3 §IV-B/VI（broadcast 源/size 识别）；AXI XBAR 2502.19215v1 §II-A（W acquire/commit）。不声称独立新颖或分区。

# shared-read RTL stage README

## Build
Use the final RTL sources and `build-argv.json` in this directory. Do not rerun `integrate.py`; it is the initial integration step and is stale. Rebuild directly from JSON argv using Python, without unsafe shell expansion.

## Run
Run binaries with their corresponding `runNN-argv.json`. Logs are `runNN.log`, traces `runNN.csv`. The execution ledger is `execution-ledger.json`.

## Key files
- `shared_pretl_read.sv`: shared physical read ownership and skid.
- `q_write_splitter.sv`: q-W adapter and child B joining.
- `hit_bypass_parent_translation.sv`: parent translation reuse cache.
- `codex-result-acceptance.md`: root acceptance summary.
- `critical-write-recipe-review.md`: targeted review of WRITE recipe and early-resume fence.

## Acceptance
Final accepted runs: 14–21, 24–27. Preserve all failures and excluded runs in place.
uncertainties: 34.075% in root acceptance may be rounded; recomputed exact from raw averages is 34.07%, should report as 34.1% or exact 34.07%.
No post-synthesis LUT/FF/timing available; declared-state audit only.
Common platform cost boundary is missing; cannot claim total area or 56B system-wide.
PTW latency is a plain DDL/DDR model delay, not MIG-matched or board measured.
Single-case deterministic runs; no statistical average over 3 runs.
run22/23 exit0 but unknown +ptw-lat; excluded from latency-sensitivity comparison.
RAW lookup counts 4 recipes may include formal prepared 2 plus forwarded 4; do not claim all four background prepare or PTW reduction by broadcast.
Ordinary tile can static trim or optimize read tile lookahead; q2 control cannot be called universally strongest.
No independent novelty or journal partition promise; only existing DMA-Latte and AXI XBAR URL claims reused.
Helper declares 8 rows but only 4 live; no physical optimization claim from that.
